text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Excusez-moi! Make way!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Haha. There she is, Speed Symboli...!
So she's the one—

text_block_list.name: Former Academy Chairwoman
text_block_list.text:
...! Do you know about
Speed Symboli?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...? Yeah.
Because the pre-race interview was pretty funny!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: "Even after feeling under the weather two races back, she went and said she'd 'build a bridge to the world' at the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe! She fully intends to take first place, you know?!"

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Ah. Wait, Japanese...
Are you here to cheer for Speed Symboli too?

text_block_list.name: Former Academy Chairwoman
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That's right.
I came to cheer for the "Japanese Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Former Academy Chairwoman
text_block_list.text:
Hey you.
If you're interested—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Compared to back then,
the world has certainly gotten a lot closer.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: It's time for a victory party, ALRIGHTTTTT!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Is it really okay not to stop them...?
When those two get together...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"No worries, no worries.
Just let 'em let loose to their heart's content."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...We might as well celebrate today.
Cafe, that goes for you too.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Being a wallflower doesn't suit you at all,
Sirius-senpai."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...You keep glancing at the entrance.
Are you waiting for someone, DESU?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: I'm just taking a break. Leave me alone.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Geez, can't be helped, desu!
Let's just turn a blind eye~.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Today is going to be a very busy day, after all.

text_block_list.name: Travel Agency Employee
text_block_list.text:
Trainer <username>!
I've been wanting to meet you for so long!
I was so moved by your races this year!

text_block_list.name: TV Station Employee
text_block_list.text:
We're planning to deliver all the inspiration you and your team gave us across two cours!
Please let us interview you soon!

"Even though it is a victory party, there is no time to eat.
One person after another comes up to talk."

All of Japan was buzzing with excitement
over <chrname>'s dramatic victory.

text_block_list.name: Townspeople A
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, who do you think is going
to the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe this year!?

text_block_list.name: Townspeople B
text_block_list.text:
I already bought my ticket to France.
This time, I'm going to watch it live on-site!

text_block_list.name: High School Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat!? You're going to
a trainer vocational school—

text_block_list.name: High School Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Shh! You're too loud.
...I might just be jumping on the bandwagon, but still.

text_block_list.name: High School Girl B
text_block_list.text:
...I was thinking of taking on the challenge.
Just like you, Trainer <username>.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Man
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... There's an even bigger crowd
swarming the racecourse today.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Indeed...
The next world champion
might just emerge from right here.

text_block_list.name: Foreign Journalist
text_block_list.text: "Whaaaat!? All three of you are running in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe next year!?"

text_block_list.name: Venus Park
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. I will have my revenge.
On my pride as an Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Rigauntona
text_block_list.text:
"Because if it's them,
they will surely reach the pinnacle of the world."

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text:
"However, before that—
racing in Japan wouldn't be half bad."

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text:
"How about it, Rigantona?
For once, instead of waiting... how about chasing?"

text_block_list.name: Rigauntona
text_block_list.text: "Oh... That's not a bad invitation."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: You two have truly become the center of the world, Trainer <username>.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Congratulatory telegrams! A large number of
bouquets have arrived from the URA as well!"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: And this is extra. For you and Mei.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...It's the old men.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...The Symboli family and the Mejiro family.
Is this the blessing of the illustrious rulers who led eras?
Tucked into the bouquet was a message card with a brief, yet beautifully written "Thank you."
choice_data_list: ...Next, it's our turn to lead everyone.
...Next, it's our turn to lead everyone.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes.
Trainer <username>."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Then without further ado!
Let's have Trainer <username> and Mei
share their thoughts with everyone!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
No time like the present!
Let's head onto the stage!!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: "Whoa, whoa, Yayoi!? That's way too reckless, even for a spur-of-the-moment idea!?"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Forgive me!

Pulled along by Chairwoman Akikawa,
Mei Satake and I were brought up to the stage.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Guest & Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...It's the hero of this victory!
Are they giving a speech? Quiet, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Umm...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Then, how about I ask Trainer <username> what everyone gathered here wants to know?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course.
You're the stars of today, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer <username>.
Tell me, for the sake of those who follow.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: "Why were you able to win the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe?"
choice_data_list: The reason I was able to win, you ask...

text_block_list.text: —I look out over the girls from atop the podium.

"...I remember. All the training up until now.
And all the people who have helped me along the way."

If she hadn't had supporters.
If she hadn't had such a rich training environment, or other Umamusume to strive toward...
If not for the Umamusume who lent their aid, and if not for the hopes entrusted to her by them...
—There was no victory for us.
choice_data_list: This is a victory we seized together.

text_block_list.text: "The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe was <chrname>'s victory, the project team's victory, and a victory for all of Japan."

The fans and Umamusume who supported me,
as well as everyone who has challenged the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe
and tried to rewrite history before――
“—Every single one of them was a 'comrade' to us.”
choice_data_list: Because I had "friends" by my side, I never gave up.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Thank you for your answer, Trainer <username>.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
And so, ladies and gentlemen.
Allow me to offer a few closing words.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"...As we aim for our next victory at the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe,
we look forward to your continued support!"
choice_data_list: Thank you for all your support!!

text_block_list.text:
"Together with Mei Satake, I bow deeply.
—For the sake of the future that lies ahead."
“—Now, let us claim victory. In the upcoming Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.”
